rationale: The agent used the product tools to identify the cheapest available mechanical keyboard variant and correctly reported its price and options ($226.11, tactile, white backlight, full size). No account data was accessed or shared, and no order-changing actions were taken, so authentication was not required. When the user indicated the price was too high and chose to keep their current keyboard, the agent did not proceed with any exchange/return—which would have required confirmation and authentication—aligning with policy. No unsupported or fabricated information was given.
